import ast,importlib.util,sys,traceback,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
src=(root/'test_unit.py').read_text()
names=[n.name for n in ast.parse(src).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('app', root/'app.py')
app=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(app)
checks={'test_value': lambda: app.VALUE==1, 'test_value_positive': lambda: app.VALUE>0}
suite=ET.Element('testsuite', name='pytest', tests=str(len(names)), failures='0', errors='0', skipped='0')
props=ET.SubElement(suite,'properties')
ET.SubElement(props,'property',name='ranex.pytest_observer',value='1')
fails=0
for name in names:
  cid=f'test_unit.py::{name}'
  case=ET.SubElement(suite,'testcase',classname='test_unit',name=name,time='0')
  try:
    assert checks[name]()
  except Exception as exc:
    fails+=1
    fail=ET.SubElement(case,'failure',message=str(exc))
    fail.text=''.join(traceback.format_exception(exc))
suite.set('failures', str(fails))
Path('governance').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
ts=ET.Element('testsuites', name='pytest tests'); ts.append(suite)
ET.ElementTree(ts).write('governance/suite_results.xml', encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
print(f'{len(names)-fails} passed, {fails} failed of {len(names)}')
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
